# Section 1: Overview

## Purpose
The purpose of this document is to bring reliability in the UI specifically with Advance Export incentive handling.

## Business Requirement
Certainly, in order to make the UI more interactive and efficient with regards to Advance Export Incentive handling.

## Scope
The Scope of these specs is to enhance the below screens:-
• Sales invoice
• Export Incentive
• Duty Script movement

# Section 2. Assumptions
• No Assumptions

# Section 3. Functional Requirement Description

# EXPORT LOGISTICS MANAGEMENT
Screen 02– Shipment Plan

## Meeting Points:
Buyer orders will be created in WFX
Shipment Plan will be created in WFX consisting of Sales Order Lines where shipment is due/ planned.
Shipment plan will be created on Customer PO (WFX delivery OC) level
Multiple OCs can be clubbed under one shipment plan
Pre-Shipment Sales Invoice (PSN) will be created based on shipment Plan created in previous stage.
Shipment plan list screen will have multiple status update will be provided (PSN created, ASN Created , Sent to FA, etc.)

## Solution=> Shipment Plan
Shipment plan will be created by selecting multiple delivery OCs as per user requirement:

## Shahi Business Requirements
The sales/ Production team will create a shipment plan that can include multiple deliveries and multiple destinations, grouped under a primary destination which will auto-populate in the Pre-Shipment Export Invoice/ Sales ASN but can be modified by the logistics team during ASN creation, where only a single destination will be selected. Multiple ASNs can be created under a single shipment plan. The shipment plan remains editable by the factory until the ASN is in the creation stage; however, once the Pre-Booking is done and ASN is completed, the shipment plan becomes locked. If any changes are made to the shipment plan, the system will trigger an email alert to the respective authorized personnel, which will act as an approval mechanism for revising either the shipment plan, PSN or the ASN. Upon such changes, the PSN/ ASN quantity will be updated based on the shipment plan (for example, reducing order quantity from 100 to 80). In the Sales ASN confirmed mode, a checkbox labeled “Applied for Booking” will be introduced; once selected, neither the shipment plan, PSN or ASN can be revised. This checkbox can only be unchecked by an authorized user based on existing permission controls, after which revisions to both ASN and shipment plan will be allowed. Additionally, once the shipment is confirmed and an e-way bill is generated, the ASN can be recreated only by cancelling the tax invoice and generating a new ASN with the existing data but a new ASN number, specifically in cases where shipment execution fails or requires correction. The shipment plan will also include a shipment tolerance percentage driven from the Buyer Master, which can vary across different Shahi divisions.
**During plan user can take multiple destinations but will have one destination as group. Same will be auto populate in Sales ASN However it can be changed as per requirement.

## Shipment Plan Screen:
Permissions will be introduced for both Creation and List screens to control access and actions based on user roles.

### Navigation
• User clicks “+ New” button on Shipment Plan List
• System opens Shipment Plan Creation Screen

### Header Section
Fields (Dropdowns)
The following dropdown fields will be available:
• Shipment Plan For
• Type: Dropdown (Mandatory) - Article
• Values: Configurable (same as ASN screen)
• Buyer
• Type: Dropdown (Mandatory)
• Source: Buyer master data
• Destination
• Type: Dropdown (Mandatory)
• Source: Predefined destination list / country master

### Action Buttons
The following actions will be available on the screen:
• Import
• First User export the excel to get desired Excel format, add on the necessary details.
• Then click on import and add that excel file.
• Now the data filled in excel gets auto-populated and in editable mode.
• Export
• User Import the format from the Shipment Plan screen consisting of all the text fields present on the screen.
• And will contains every single data in a excel format.
• Add
• Add functionality will open a pop-up of Select Order list with same functionality as currently in Sales ASN.

• Delete
• Deletes selected row(s) from grid
• Multi-select supported

### Order Details Grid
Grid Behavior
• Displays shipment line items
• Supports:
• Row selection
• Inline editing
• Bulk actions (Delete)

### Editable Fields
Shipment Qty
• Type: Numeric Input
• Mandatory: Yes
• Validation:
• Cannot be empty
• Must be greater than 0
• Cannot exceed Ordered Qty (if applicable) – it should consider the shipment tolerance.
Function and controls should work as stated in business requirements above.

## Shipment Plan List

### Header Level Features
At the header level, the following functionalities will be available:
• A search bar will be provided to allow users to search shipment plans using Shipment Plan Number.
• A master checkbox will be available on the header.
• When selected → all grid-level checkboxes will automatically be selected.
• When unselected → all grid-level checkboxes will be deselected.
• A header-level context menu will be available with the following options:
• Cancel
• Update Price
• Update Sustainability
• These actions will apply to all selected shipment plans (based on checkbox selection).

### Grid Level Features:
Each row in the Shipment Plan grid will have:
• A row-level checkbox for individual selection.
• A context menu with the following options:
• Log
• Revise
• Revision Log
Behaviour:
• Actions here are specific to the selected row only.
• “Revise” will follow business rules (e.g., not allowed if locked / booking applied).

### Column-Level Filters (Inline Filters)
• Each column header will have:
• Input field / dropdown filter
• Filter icon for advanced filtering
• Users can filter data column-wise independently (e.g., Buyer, Status, GDN No., etc.)
• Filters will work in combination (multi-column filtering supported).

### Sidebar Filter (Advanced Filter Panel)
• A right-side collapsible filter panel will be available.
• This panel will include all grid fields as filter options:
• Status
• Shipment Plan No.
• Buyer Company
• End Customer
• GDN No.
• Contract No.
• Invoice No.
• Allows advanced filtering with multiple fields at once
• Works in sync with:
• Column filters
• Search bar

### Status
The Status column in the Shipment Plan List will represent the current stage of the shipment plan based on system transactions and document creation. The statuses are defined as follows:
• Saved: Indicates that the shipment plan is in draft state and has been saved but not yet confirmed.
• Confirmed: Indicates that the shipment plan has been finalized and the transaction is confirmed.
• Closed: Indicates that the ASN (Advanced Shipment Notice) has been successfully created against the shipment plan.
• Booked: Indicates that the PSN Invoice has been generated for the shipment plan, confirming booking completion.

### Progress Column
The Progress column will display the following stages:
• PSN Created
Indicates that the PSN (Packing Slip Note) / Invoice has been generated for the shipment plan.
• ASN Created
Indicates that the ASN (Advanced Shipment Notice) has been created against the shipment plan.
• Sent to Finance
Indicates that the shipment details/documents have been sent to Factory/Finance Authority (FA) for further processing.
Shipment Plan list will have limited columns compared to Sales ASN.
Shipment plan will have 2 status “Confirmed” or “Closed”. Confirmed will be based on shipment plan created. Status will turn to “Closed” if ASN is created against “Shipment Plan” in Confirmed mode.
Revision of Shipment will be blocked if ASN is created in confirmed mode.
In case ASN is in Saved mode, then user will be able to revise Shipment Plan. However, while confirming ASN post revision system will show alert that Shipment plan has been revised.
In case user wants to revise a shipment plan where confirmed Sales ASN has already been created then user has to cancel the ASN or revise to keep in Saved mode.
